notes.title: Update for the New Year! V0.2
notes.content:
Hello all! Happy to announce that for the new year we've implemented some Quality of Life changes! Thank you for all the feedback, it's incredibly helpful.

[list]
[*] Added a 'quit to windows' option at title screen
[*] Added a more intuitive 'return to game' option in the pause menu.
[/list]
